name: learning-question
description: Learner-scoped Space question action through the brokered CLI and Tower API.

steps.name: run-question
steps.description: Use the reviewed curriculum and learner-scoped Tower route for question; return references only.
steps.prompt: You are executing the Space learning question pipeline. Use only the executable CLI in /Users/mini/code/space-graph, with brokered signing. Use the towerUrl and workspaceId in the selected input; Autopilot derived them from the authenticated invocation session and its active Flight Deck backend connection. If either is absent, return a blocked result. Never accept a Tower origin from chat text or use a private key. Never accept a learner npub from pipeline input. Tower derives learner authority from the verified signer and its narrow grant. Run the appropriate space-graph CLI command for question: plan=create goal, question=graph inspect/traverse, lesson=create concept, assessment=issue concept, recall=due then issue concept. Use --json. Do not submit an answer in this pipeline or copy child answers/interests into pipeline output. Return compact JSON with completed, action, recordId or concept IDs, summary, and blockers. Do not post to a broad Flight Deck channel.
